map.根据厨房电器总功率与同时使用系数，计算需用功率、计算电流，推荐断路器规格与导线截: Calculate the required power and load current from the total kitchen appliance power and simultaneous-use factor, and recommend circuit breaker ratings and conductor cross-sections.
map.由电器总功率 P、同时使用系数 Kd、功率因数 cosφ 与电压 U 计算计算电: From total appliance power P, simultaneous-use factor Kd, power factor cos phi and voltage U, compute the load current; recommend a matching circuit breaker and conductor cross-section using standard breaker ratings and the copper wire ampacity table.
map.💡 需用功率 Pj=P×Kd；计算电流 Ij=Pj×1000/(U×cosφ)；: Tip: required power Pj = P times Kd; load current Ij = Pj times 1000 / (U times cos phi); breaker In at least Ij times 1.25; select conductor by ampacity.
map.厨房大功率电器：电磁炉 2~3kW、烤箱 2~3.5kW、微波炉 1~1.5kW: Large kitchen appliances: induction cooker 2 to 3 kW, oven 2 to 3.5 kW, microwave 1 to 1.5 kW, water heater 3 to 5 kW
map.同时使用系数一般取 0.6~0.8，电器多且不同时用取低值: Simultaneous-use factor is usually 0.6 to 0.8; take the lower value when many appliances are not used at the same time
map.铜芯导线载流量：1.5mm²≈16A、2.5mm²≈25A、4mm²≈32A、6: Copper wire ampacity: 1.5 mm2 about 16 A, 2.5 mm2 about 25 A, 4 mm2 about 32 A, 6 mm2 about 40 A, 10 mm2 about 50 A
map.📚 深度解析：厨电功率匹配（断路器与导线选型）: In-depth: Kitchen Appliance Power Matching (breaker and conductor selection)
map.厨房配电：按总功率与同时系数算需用功率与计算电流: Kitchen power distribution: compute required power and load current from total power and simultaneous-use factor
map.保护选型：选断路器额定电流与铜芯导线截面: Protection selection: choose breaker rated current and copper conductor cross-section
map.负荷分级：判断轻载/中载/重载，指导回路划分: Load grading: judge light, medium, heavy load to guide circuit division
map.算法：需用功率 Pj = 总功率×同时系数；计算电流 Ij = Pj×1000/: Algorithm: required power Pj = total power times simultaneous factor; load current Ij = Pj times 1000 / (U times cos phi); breaker takes the standard rating at least Ij times 1.25 (16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100, 125, 160, 200, 250 A); conductor takes the smallest rating whose ampacity is at least Ij times 1.25 (1.5/16, 2.5/25, 4/32, 6/40, 10/50, 16/63, 25/80, 35/100, 50/125, 70/160 and so on); load level: below 3 kW light, below 8 kW medium, below 15 kW heavy, otherwise extra heavy.
map.例：总功率 15kW、同时系数 0.7、cosφ=0.85、220V → 需用功: Example: total 15 kW, simultaneous factor 0.7, cos phi 0.85, 220 V gives required power 10.5 kW, load current 56.1 A, choose 80 A breaker (load rate 70 percent) plus 25 mm2 copper wire (ampacity 80 A), judged as heavy load (commercial or large kitchen) single-phase 220 V. If total 6 kW, simultaneous factor 0.6, cos phi 0.9 gives required 3.6 kW, current 18.2 A, choose 25 A breaker (load rate 73 percent) plus 2.5 mm2 copper wire (ampacity 25 A), belonging to medium load (regular kitchen).
map.同时系数怎么取？: How to choose the simultaneous-use factor?
map.家用厨房通常 0.5~0.7（不会所有电器同时满载），商用后厨 0.7~0.9。: Home kitchens usually 0.5 to 0.7 (not all appliances run at full load at once), commercial kitchens 0.7 to 0.9. Occasions with many high-power devices (steam cabinets, fryers) should have a separate circuit and a higher factor.
map.为什么断路器和导线都按 1.25 倍选？: Why size both breaker and conductor at 1.25 times?
map.为长时负荷留裕量：断路器需躲过电动机启动与短时冲击电流不误跳，导线需避免长期过载: To leave margin for sustained load: the breaker must avoid nuisance tripping from motor starts and short surges, the conductor must avoid long-term overload heating. 1.25 is a common simplified value; long-distance runs also need a voltage drop check.
